description: The native Forebrain chat workbench in VS Code's side bar, plus a Sessions view, approvals and editor-to-chat commands.
capability.untrustedWorkspaces: Forebrain runs commands and reads this folder; it stays off until you trust the folder.
command.openWebUiInBrowser: Forebrain: Open Web UI in Browser
config.title: Forebrain
config.gatewayUrl: The Forebrain gateway's HTTP(S) origin, without a path (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:6060).
config.binaryPath: Path of the forebrain binary used to start a gateway when none is running. Empty: look up `forebrain` on PATH.
config.autoStartGateway: Start a gateway when the configured origin does not answer and no token is stored yet.
config.selectionTarget: Where Ask About Selection/File sends: the session the panel is showing, or always a new one.
config.selectionTarget.current: The session the panel is showing
config.includeDiagnostics: Append the file's current diagnostics to the prompt of Ask About Selection/File.
config.approvalNotifications: Show a VS Code notification for an approval that arrives while the chat panel is not visible.
